info.title: Modulus.Cli
info.description: CLI tool for scaffolding .NET modular monolith solutions with built-in CQRS mediator, messaging, and Aspire support.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Modulus - Modular Monolith CLI scaffolding tool

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: init
commands.description: Scaffold a new modular monolith solution

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory (default: current directory)

options.name: --aspire
options.description: Include .NET Aspire AppHost and ServiceDefaults projects [default: False]

options.name: --transport
options.description: Messaging transport to pre-configure (inmemory, rabbitmq, azureservicebus) [default: inmemory]

options.name: --no-git
options.description: Skip git init and initial commit [default: False]

options.name: --modulus-kit-version
options.description: Override the ModulusKit.* package version emitted into Directory.Packages.props (default: CLI's own version)

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would be created without writing any files or running any processes. [default: False]

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: Skip running 'dotnet restore' after scaffolding. [default: False]

options.name: --ci
options.description: Scaffold a CI workflow for the given provider (currently only 'github' is supported). Omit to skip.

options.name: --dockerfile
options.description: Scaffold a multi-stage Dockerfile (and .dockerignore) building the WebApi host. [default: False]

arguments.name: SOLUTION_NAME
arguments.description: PascalCase name of the solution to create

commands.name: add-module
commands.description: Add a new module to an existing Modulus solution

options.name: --solution
options.description: Path to the solution file (default: auto-find in current or parent directories)

options.name: --no-endpoints
options.description: Skip creating the Api project (for backend-only modules) [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would be created without writing any files or running any processes. [default: False]

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: Skip running 'dotnet restore' after scaffolding. [default: False]

arguments.name: MODULE_NAME
arguments.description: PascalCase name of the module to add

commands.name: remove-module
commands.description: Remove a module from an existing Modulus solution

options.name: --solution
options.description: Path to the solution file (default: auto-find in current or parent directories)

options.name: --confirm
options.description: Apply the removal. Without this flag, only a dry run is printed. [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Proceed even if other modules still reference this module. [default: False]

arguments.name: MODULE_NAME
arguments.description: PascalCase name of the module to remove

commands.name: add-entity
commands.description: Add a new entity to an existing module

options.name: --module
options.description: Name of the target module

options.name: --solution
options.description: Path to the solution file (default: auto-find in current or parent directories)

options.name: --aggregate
options.description: Generate as AggregateRoot instead of Entity [default: False]

options.name: --id-type
options.description: ID type: guid (default), int, long, string, or a custom StronglyTypedId name [default: guid]

options.name: --properties
options.description: Comma-separated properties in Name:Type format (e.g. "Name:string,Email:string,IsActive:bool")

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would be created without writing any files. [default: False]

arguments.name: ENTITY_NAME
arguments.description: PascalCase name of the entity to add

commands.name: add-command

options.name: --module

options.name: --solution

options.name: --result-type

options.description: Print what would be created without writing any files. [default: False]

arguments.name: COMMAND_NAME

options.description: Name of the target module

options.name: --result-type
options.description: The result type T in Result<T> (required for queries)

options.name: --solution
options.description: Path to the solution file (default: auto-find in current or parent directories)

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would be created without writing any files. [default: False]

arguments.name: QUERY_NAME

commands.name: add-endpoint

options.name: --solution

commands.name: add-consumer
commands.description: Add an integration event handler to a module and wire the cross-module reference

arguments.name: EVENT_NAME

commands.name: add-migration
commands.description: Add an EF Core migration for a module's DbContext (wraps 'dotnet ef migrations add' with the solution's project layout)

options.name: --module
options.description: The module whose DbContext the migration targets

options.name: --solution
options.description: Path to the solution file (default: auto-find in current or parent directories)

options.name: --context
options.description: DbContext class name (default: {Module}DbContext). The read-only context never gets migrations.

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Migrations directory relative to the module's Infrastructure project (default: Migrations) [default: Migrations]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print the exact 'dotnet ef' invocation without running it. [default: False]

arguments.name: MIGRATION_NAME
arguments.description: PascalCase name of the migration (e.g. AddOrderTable)

commands.name: outbox
commands.description: Inspect and operate the transactional outbox.

commands.name: list-failed
commands.description: List dead-lettered outbox messages whose attempt count exceeds the retry threshold.

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: Database connection string. If omitted, read from Messaging:ConnectionString in --config (or ./appsettings.json).

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to appsettings.json (default: ./appsettings.json in the current directory).

options.name: --provider
options.description: EF Core provider for the outbox database. [default: SqlServer]

options.name: --max-attempts
options.description: Threshold above which a message is considered dead-lettered. Should match MessagingOptions.RetryPolicy.MaxAttempts (default: 5). [default: 5]

commands.name: retry
commands.description: Reset attempt count and clear the last-error so the outbox processor will retry the message.

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: Database connection string. If omitted, read from Messaging:ConnectionString in --config (or ./appsettings.json).

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to appsettings.json (default: ./appsettings.json in the current directory).

options.name: --provider
options.description: EF Core provider for the outbox database. [default: SqlServer]

commands.name: purge
commands.description: Permanently delete an outbox message.

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: Database connection string. If omitted, read from Messaging:ConnectionString in --config (or ./appsettings.json).

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to appsettings.json (default: ./appsettings.json in the current directory).

options.name: --provider
options.description: EF Core provider for the outbox database. [default: SqlServer]

commands.name: purge-processed
commands.description: Bulk-delete successfully published outbox messages older than a retention age. Without --confirm, reports what would be deleted.

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: Database connection string. If omitted, read from Messaging:ConnectionString in --config (or ./appsettings.json).

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to appsettings.json (default: ./appsettings.json in the current directory).

options.name: --provider
options.description: EF Core provider for the outbox database. [default: SqlServer]

options.name: --older-than-days
options.description: Purge processed messages whose ProcessedAt is older than this many days (default: 7). [default: 7]

options.name: --batch-size
options.description: Maximum rows deleted per round trip; batches repeat until drained (default: 500). [default: 500]

options.name: --confirm
options.description: Actually delete. Without this flag the command only reports the matching row count. [default: False]

commands.name: inbox
commands.description: Inspect and operate the consumer inbox.

commands.name: purge
commands.description: Bulk-delete inbox messages (and their consumer rows) older than a retention age. Without --confirm, reports what would be deleted.

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: Database connection string. If omitted, read from ConnectionStrings:Default in --config (or ./appsettings.json).

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to appsettings.json (default: ./appsettings.json in the current directory).

options.name: --provider
options.description: EF Core provider for the inbox database. [default: SqlServer]

options.name: --older-than-days
options.description: Purge inbox messages that occurred more than this many days ago (default: 7). Purged rows leave the deduplication window — only purge past the broker's maximum redelivery horizon. [default: 7]

options.name: --batch-size
options.description: Maximum rows deleted per round trip; batches repeat until drained (default: 500). [default: 500]

options.name: --confirm
options.description: Actually delete. Without this flag the command only reports the matching row count. [default: False]

commands.name: dlq
commands.description: Inspect and replay broker dead-letter queues.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List dead-lettered messages on the broker (RabbitMQ: destructive peek — messages are requeued after reading).

options.name: --transport
options.description: The broker to talk to.

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: Broker connection string. If omitted, read from Messaging:ConnectionString in --config (or ./appsettings.json).

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to appsettings.json (default: ./appsettings.json in the current directory).

options.name: --endpoint
options.description: Endpoint name whose dead-letter queue to operate on. If omitted, read from Messaging:EndpointName in --config.

options.name: --event
options.description: Full event type name (e.g. MyApp.Orders.Integration.OrderPlacedEvent). Required for Azure Service Bus, whose DLQs are per topic/subscription.

options.name: --max
options.description: Maximum messages to read (list) or examine (replay). [default: 50]

commands.name: replay
commands.description: Re-publish dead-lettered messages to their original destination. Handlers that already succeeded are skipped by the inbox.

options.name: --transport
options.description: The broker to talk to.

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: Broker connection string. If omitted, read from Messaging:ConnectionString in --config (or ./appsettings.json).

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to appsettings.json (default: ./appsettings.json in the current directory).

options.name: --endpoint
options.description: Endpoint name whose dead-letter queue to operate on. If omitted, read from Messaging:EndpointName in --config.

options.name: --event
options.description: Full event type name (e.g. MyApp.Orders.Integration.OrderPlacedEvent). Required for Azure Service Bus, whose DLQs are per topic/subscription.

options.name: --max
options.description: Maximum messages to read (list) or examine (replay). [default: 50]

options.name: --message-id
options.description: Replay a single message by its MessageId (the integration event's EventId).

options.name: --all
options.description: Replay every dead-lettered message, up to --max. [default: False]

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Validates the health of a Modulus-scaffolded solution without building it.

options.name: --solution
options.description: Path to the solution file (default: auto-find in current or parent directories)

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit results as a single JSON document instead of human-readable output. [default: False]

options.name: --strict
options.description: Treat warnings as failures for exit-code purposes (exit code 2 when only warnings are present). [default: False]

commands.name: upgrade
commands.description: Bumps all ModulusKit.* package pins in Directory.Packages.props to a target version.

options.name: --version
options.description: Target ModulusKit.* package version (default: the CLI's own version).

options.name: --solution
options.description: Path to the solution file (default: auto-find in current or parent directories)

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show the version changes without writing Directory.Packages.props. [default: False]

commands.name: version
commands.description: Display the Modulus CLI version
